scalars.scalar_value: RECRUITMENT PERIOD ONE MONTH: Applicants will be screened after two weeks; and then on a weekly basis.  The position can be filled prior to the apply by date.
Experience catheterizing blood vessels and urinary track.
Experience working in a Small Animal Hospital as a veterinary technician.

items.item_text: Must obtain a Veterinary Medical Controlled Substance Permit (VACSP) within 3 months of date of hire.
Current California Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) license.
Experience working in a Small Animal Hospital as a veterinary technician.
Experience catheterizing blood vessels and urinary track.
Experience in aseptic nursing and sterile techniques.
Experience in emergency critical care medicine.

Independent of supervision in a hospital setting, as a significant part of daily duties, responsible for treatment of patients with life-threatening illness or injury, whose conditions are likely to change on a moment-to-moment basis. Provide paraveterinary technical support to the Small Animal Clinic Veterinarians. Responsible for the treatment of patients, blood bank support, student instruction, clinician support and facility support.
50% - Small Animal Clinic Patient Care in the Intermediate Care Ward
30% - Small Animal Patient Care in the General Ward

Skill to independently provide intense moment to moment monitoring and reassessment of emergent, critically ill patients with life-threatening illness or injury, whose conditions are likely to change on a moment-to-moment basis.
